name: Lustful Dreams: The Forbidden Connection
source: Begin a journey shrouded in mystery and laden with emotion in 'Lustful Dreams: The Forbidden Connection'. The story opens as the main protagonist awakens from a dream unlike any other—a sign that the story will deeply explore the mysteries of the mind and the truth behind what we see and feel. This visual novel follows the protagonist and Ayumi, cohabitants navigating the complexities of their evolving bond amidst a world where dreams and reality start to blur. As the dreams start to uncover, their hearts start to open following questionable desires. At the very beginning you'll be prompted to choose their relationship—whether as siblings, step-siblings, or childhood friends—and guide them through moments of discovery and introspection.
